answer: Each agent leases one numbered irrigation sluice at a shared oasis, and that lease cannot be transferred during the epoch. Water is released only in a twelve-minute window after dawn, and the sluice meter signs a yield ticket naming both the sluice id and the agent's key. A farm that tries to run two identities would need two sluices in the same short window; the orchard ledger rejects overlapping meter signatures that share a pump or operator, so extra identities simply cannot water a second plot.
